readout: identity across a window the width of the read, centred on the reported match. A real relative holds its identity into the padding; a chance match decays to background outside its block
bias: mate 1 only, so no pair statement is available. Organism names are NCBI's annotation and travel through unchecked. References over the length cap are inventoried without an alignment, and the cap correlates with organism - large genomes are cellular - so the aligned subset leans viral relative to the inventory
